fragments.body:
`pose dora-metrics` now reports the current five production delivery metrics,
replacing the former Reliability proxy with deployment rework rate and limiting
recovery time to resolved incidents explicitly caused by a deployment. New
deployment and incident events require rework/environment classification;
schema-v1 JSONL remains readable without guessed values.

Managed manual refreshes once again preserve each installed repository's own
project name instead of replacing it with the POSE source repository name.

POSE now measures local CLI and MCP tool usage automatically and exposes
privacy-bounded aggregates through `pose usage` and `pose_usage`, including
semantic outcomes, finding lifecycle and latency without agent-maintained
counters or individual tracking.
